newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wienerberger says eyes more acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Wienerberger says eyes more acquisitions.

text.p: Austrian brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie said on Monday it was eyeing new acquisitions in the international building materials business to help it cement its position as one of the industry's top players.

"We want to continue our ascent in the international building materials industry," Wienerberger spokesman Gerhard Bachmaier told Reuters after the group announced the sale of its Treibacher Schleifmittel unit to a German industrial group for an undisclosed sum.
"We want to use the proceeds to make further aquisitions in the building materials area," he added.

Wienerberger made a string of acquisitions to strengthen its hold on the European brick market over the past years, including Belgium's Terca Bricks in April of last year and France' Sturm in the second half of 1995.
The group is majority controlled by Austria's Creditanstalt and Belgium's Koramic. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
